system.description:
Skills: Cyber +20, Computer +10

You begin with a T-90 Patrol Drone (Opponents compendium, Individual-Scale Opponents → Drone), controlled through your com. Drone rules: you control one drone at a time, from up to 100km away (planet-wide through a settlement's network). Flying drones gain a Defence (Dodge) bonus equal to your Cyber bonus; Walker Drones cannot Dodge or Parry. All drones gain a To Hit bonus equal to your Cyber bonus. Drones can't use skills, but you can use Social skills through one at −5 Social Factor (Intimidate is unaffected). Player-owned drones don't benefit from Continuous Attack, and can be hacked (resist with Computer). Buying: T-90 Patrol Drone 20,000cr, Walker Drone 300,000cr (common, on industrial worlds that sell Heavy Weapons); Apex-Fire Combat Drone 100,000cr, Manticore HN Walker Drone 2,000,000cr, Pendragon Support Drone 5,000,000cr, Type X Walker Drone 15,000,000cr (rare).
